section2_stratifications.rebucketing_note: Numeric stratification dimensions use empirical quintiles over the full corpus. Composition dimensions keep zero/no-points buckets separate and use quintiles over the positive population. Intrinsic first-two-games and early-game buckets remain intentionally imbalanced.
section2_stratifications.terminology_note: All Section 2 tables are descriptive only; no statistical significance claims are made.
